passages.context: The complete short article was inspected. It identifies a small mid-fifth-century Gallic collection known through later compilers rather than an extant independent collection, gives CCSL 148 pp. 166-185 for Munier's edition, and reports Munier's attribution to Gennadius. The publication treats that attribution as a reported modern conclusion, not an independently audited fact.
